title: SCHC: shared-vector consumption gaps across stacks
description: Cross-implementation vector coverage is uneven for spec/03-adaptation.md 5.5-5.7; behavior is implemented but several shared vectors have no consumer in some stacks. Evidence: (a) rust/lichen-schc/tests/adaptation_vectors.rs explicitly skips the port_boundary, compressed_size and single_active categories (delegated to Python) — Rust compressor-side port 5680/5695 boundary tests absent (decode-side covered by rule5_decompression.rs:58-116); (b) Rust does not consume rule_versioning.json admission_policy_vectors (only python/tests/test_protocol_vector_security.py:906-930); (c) test/vectors/schc_session_security.json, authenticated_schc_dio.json and schc_tile_sizing.json have no C consumer; (d) C consumes neither schc_adaptation.json nor rule_versioning.json (hand-mirrored C tests instead). Suggested placement: extend the rust adaptation_vectors runner and the C test harnesses (lichen/tests/schc_*). Filed from spec-coverage sweep 2026-08-31 (matrix notes; supports R-03-014/065/031).
